1.

Heard Mr. K Boruah, learned counsel for the petitioner and Mr. K.K. Parashar, learned Addl. PP,
appearing for the respondent No.1.
2.

The petitioner has filed an application under section 482 Cr.P.C., read with section 401 Cr.P.C.,
challenging the order dated 02.03.2023 passed by Page No.# 2/3 the learned SDJM, Golaghat in GR Case No.39/2023 (corresponding to Ghiladhari PS Case No.02/2023) under sections 120(B)/379/411/420/34 IPC.

sentences.text:
A police report was called for, as to whether the vehicle is required for further investigation but no report has been sent till date.
4.
The learned Addl. PP has submitted that case diary has been forwarded.
5. I have considered the submissions at the bar and I have also perused the impugned order.

6. The impugned order was passed on 02.03.2023 by the learned SDJM, Golaghat rejecting the prayer for zimma of the vehicle seized in connection with this case, as the I.O had raised objection that the vehicle may again be used for transporting smuggled areca nuts.
7. It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that the vehicle was purchased on hire purchase basis recently at a monthly installment of Rs.50,000/-, to be borne by the petitioner.
The individuals who hired the vehicle were involved with the smuggling of areca nuts and not the petitioner.
8. The petitioner will suffer immensely if the vehicle is left in the open and it will get damaged.
The vehicle was recently purchased for business purpose.
9. Case diary reveals that the police could not ascertain whether the areca nuts transported through the vehicle are of Indian origin or Burmese origin.
The impugned order was passed on 02.03.2023 on the basis of the report of the I/O.
At present investigation may have been presumably progressed.
10. It is also submitted that the case diary reveals that the vehicle was hired from the petitioner.
Page No.# 3/3 11.
The learned SDJM, Golaghat is directed to handover the custody of the vehicle to the registered owner of the vehicle under the conditions to be imposed by the learned SDJM, Golaghat.
12. In terms of the above, the instant petition stands disposed of.
